target: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for forward transfer using a new-task warm-start experiment. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

competency.title: Diagnose forward transfer — independent holdout
competency.outcome: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for forward transfer using a new-task warm-start experiment. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
competency.practice_task: Produce a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair grounded in a new-task warm-start experiment.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report initial new-task performance versus scratch with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: counting test-task exposure as transfer.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of forward transfer.
Practice: the repair fixes the target without hiding a regression.
Measurement: report initial new-task performance versus scratch against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for counting test-task exposure as transfer; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
